summary: Tested the two new features on JP Directory Phase 2: (1) WhatsApp buttons on ceramic/yard listing rows and (2) Bulk CSV import for ceramics & yards + phone field on models/forms. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passing across CSV import validation, RBAC, missing-field partial success, port validation, seed backfill and phone CRUD. Frontend: WhatsApp buttons render with correct wa.me/91xxxxx hrefs and target=_blank; Template downloads produce ceramics_template.csv / yards_template.csv; CSV upload shows 'Imported N rows' toast and new rows appear in the list; phone field is present in both ceramic and yard admin forms. One HIGH bug: the admin ceramic row does NOT display the phone number in the metadata line (yard admin row does).

ui_bugs.issue: Phone number is not displayed in the ceramic admin row metadata. Current metadata line only shows '{category} · {map_url}'. Review requirement explicitly states 'Admin row for ceramics/yards displays phone number in metadata line alongside category/port.' Yards row already does this correctly (line 576) but the ceramic row (lines 496-506) omits `{c.phone && ...}`.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.jsx around line 497, add phone display to the ceramic admin row metadata, matching how yard row shows it. Example: `{c.category}{c.phone && <> · {c.phone}} · {c.map_url}`
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage.jsx: ceramic admin row missing phone in metadata line (asymmetry with yard row).
server.py: startup backfill migration works but is O(N) inserts per boot; consider a single migration flag once stable.
CSV import silently accepts any values for phone (no format validation); acceptable for MVP but note for future.

success_rate.frontend: 94% (17/18 checks - phone display on ceramic admin row missing)

seed_data_creation: Tests use TEST_/UITEST/UIYARD prefixes. Cleanup performed after run - no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend CSV import is fully working. If retesting after the phone-display fix on ceramic admin row, only need to verify the ceramic row on /admin > Ceramics shows the phone next to category (currently it only shows category and map URL). The 6 seed yards already have phone populated by backfill; same for the 5 seed ceramics.
rca of the issue: AdminPage.jsx ceramic row template was written before the phone field was added; when phone support was later added to the model and form, the yard row template was updated to include `{y.phone && ...}` but the equivalent line for ceramic row was missed. Fix: mirror the yard row's phone rendering into the ceramic row's metadata div.
